project_metadata.client: MerPerle DaLat Hotel / Khai Vy Group

golden_rules: RULE 1: ABSOLUTELY NEVER modify or alter the core SQL Server database 'EMS_KHAIVY' (no ALTER TABLE, no column addition, no drop, no schema change). Old desktop Cana app runs concurrently.
RULE 2: NEVER refactor or rewrite the system from scratch. Always inherit and incrementally extend.
RULE 3: NEVER report a task as PASS/COMPLETE without real verification test (e.g. Playwright script with screenshot evidence).
RULE 4: NEVER break existing core functionalities (Scheduler, Bookings, BEO Formatter & Print, Items Master, Customer CRM, Audit Trail, Analytics).
RULE 5: After modifying code, always run 'python d:\DATTIEC\sync_and_restart.py' to deploy, backup, and restart services on 10.17.10.12.

sql_server.role: Central legacy hotel database (Bookings, Menus, Customers, Halls, Items)
sql_server.access: Read / Update via strict stored queries or parameterized SQL matching legacy logic

sqlite_audit.role: Immutable action logs (User audit trail, booking changes, BEO saves, item edits)
sqlite_audit.access: Local Read / Write, synced across server

architecture.frontend: Modern Responsive Vanilla HTML5 + JavaScript ES6 + TailwindCSS / Lucide Icons

database_core_tables.stBooking: Master banquet booking records (stBooking_ID, stBooking_Code, stShift_ID, dtDate, numPerson, numTable, numTotal_Amount, fcStatus...)
database_core_tables.stBooking_Detail: Line items for booking (dishes, setup, drinks, charges, unit price, quantity, vat)
database_core_tables.stRoom_Setup: Hall notes, department notes, and room arrangement instructions for BEO (stBooking_ID, fcHall_ID, fcNote, fcDepartment_ID...)
database_core_tables.sys_Customer: Customer directory (sys_Customer_ID, fcCustomer_Name, fcPhone, fcAddress, fcTax_Code, fcNote...)
database_core_tables.stDepartment: Departments list (001: Bep/Kitchen, 002: Nha Hang/F&B, 005: Ky Thuat/IT, 015: Thu Ngan/Cashier, 008: Buong Phong/HK...)
database_core_tables.stItems: Master items and dish catalog (stItem_ID, fcItem_Name, numPrice, fcUnit, fcRevenue_Group_ID...)
database_core_tables.stTable_Status: Hall booking status codes (ORDER, HOLD, DEPOSIT, CONFIRM, CANCEL)

ems_web_8090.desc: Returns bookings grid for halls and date range
Query bookings, search by date/status, or create new booking
Get booking details, update booking, cancel booking
Fetch complete BEO layout data, save BEO notes for departments
Render formatted printable BEO view for all departments
Query dish & item catalog, filter by revenue group A-T, update items
CRM customer lookup, merge duplicates, customer booking history
Retrieve user action logs with filtering by user, action, and date range

ems_analytics_8088.desc: KPI overview: revenue, pax, booking count, conversion rates
Revenue by groups A-T (Food, Drinks, Sound/Light, Hall rental)

ai_agent_instructions.how_to_diagnose: Read PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION/MASTER_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and CHANGELOG.md first. Always inspect the relevant backend and frontend source files before altering code.
ai_agent_instructions.how_to_apply_changes: 1. Make focused edits. 2. Verify with Playwright or integration script. 3. Run sync_and_restart.py to auto-snapshot and restart services. 4. Document changes in CHANGELOG.md.
